title: 第003章 教规不允许婚前行为
slug: 醉酒亲错人年下弟弟失控发疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

隔天舒楹没有等人来接，吃过午饭就办了出院。

sy：【我今天好得差不多了，团队有事，晚点回】

是栀栀呀：【好的姐姐，有哪里不舒服随时找我噢~】

屏幕上跳出一个乖巧小猫的表情包，舒楹回了个“嗯”就退了出来。

“跟谁聊天你这个表情？”驾驶位上的余露分神看了她一眼。

“我妹。”

“你妹跟你倒是不太像。”余露勉强从记忆中翻找出一张清纯的脸。

她俩是大学室友，友谊延续至今，对彼此的家事都有耳闻。

舒楹跟继父家的关系中规中矩，三年前她丈夫去世，留下八位数的欠款。她有不得已的原因要还债，却始终未曾向钟曼云开过口。

不仅动用了生父的遗产，三年来每天都在忙着赚快钱。

抛弃了嘴热爱的电影事业，接商单、拍短视频，抖上的爆款转场、变装视频大半都是出自她的团队。

这点上余露很佩服舒楹。

天生浓颜，读大学时就靠着骑车穿搭的视频在ins上走红。长成她这样想走捷径有的是路子，但她没有。

一个人把绵绵养大，拼死拼活地还清了欠款……

“长得好算什么，命好就行了。”舒楹早就对外貌感到麻木，闭了闭眼，试图赶走脑海中那个不该存在的人。

余露不想看美人一脸颓丧的模样，把她带到造型工作室，打扮一新地前往郊外的红酒庄园。

晚上的酒会是圈内的一位投资人举办的。

余露这几年转行做起了制片，去年上映的一部小成本电影收获10亿票房，攒了些人脉。

见过那么多新生代导演，她始终认为没人能盖过舒楹的光芒，想看看有没有合适她的工作机会。

“《捞月亮的人》，你真的不想重启吗？”舒楹跟在余露身边见了几个大佬，名片散出去不少，愿意给她机会的都是偏商业性质的项目。

一来舒楹沉寂了好几年，二来她不愿报出她那位人尽皆知的作家父亲，等于背后没有资本。

《捞月亮的人》是舒父作品里最小众的一部短篇小说，也是舒楹的最爱，在宿舍喝得烂醉的时候说过她想把这部小说搬上大荧幕。

余露不希望舒楹的才华被埋没，颇有些恨铁不成钢地说：“这几年舒涯的作品都被拍得差不多了，这部一直没对外授权，你要拍的话怎么都有人买账。”

“还不太行。”舒楹摇了摇头，“绵绵那边我放心不下。”

余露在心里叹了口气，想不通她这位什么都好的漂亮姐妹，怎么一路走来全是坎坷。

The next day, Shu Ying was discharged from the hospital after lunch without waiting for anyone to pick her up.

sy: [I’m almost feeling better today. The team has something to do, so I’ll be back later]

It’s Zhizhi: [Okay sister, come to me anytime if you feel uncomfortable~]

An emoticon of a well-behaved kitten popped up on the screen, and Shu Ying replied with a "hmm" and exited.

"Who are you talking to with this expression?" Yu Lu from the driver's seat glanced at her distractedly.

"My sister."

"Your sister doesn't look much like you." Yu Lu reluctantly found an innocent face from her memory.

They were roommates in college, and their friendship continues to this day, and they all know each other's family affairs.

Shu Ying's relationship with her stepfather's family was quite normal. Her husband passed away three years ago, leaving an eight-figure debt.She had a last resort to pay off her debts, but she never spoke to Zhong Manyun.

Not only did he use his biological father's inheritance, he also worked hard to make quick money every day for three years.

She gave up her beloved film career to take business orders and shoot short videos. Most of the popular transition and cross-dressing videos on TikTok were produced by her team.

Yu Lu admires Shu Ying for this.

She is naturally pretty, and she became famous on Instagram for her riding and outfit videos when she was in college.There were plenty of ways to take shortcuts when she grew up like this, but she didn't.

One person raised Mianmian and worked hard to pay off the debt...

"It doesn't matter if you look good, as long as you have a good life." Shu Ying had long been numb to appearance and closed his eyes, trying to get rid of the person in his mind that shouldn't exist.

Yu Lu didn't want to see the beauty look depressed, so she took her to the styling studio, dressed up and headed to the red wine estate in the suburbs.

The evening reception was hosted by an investor in the circle.

In the past few years, Yu Lu has switched careers and started producing. A small-budget movie released last year earned 1 billion in box office, and she has accumulated some connections.

Having met so many new-generation directors, she always believed that no one could outshine Shu Ying and wanted to see if there were any suitable job opportunities for her.

"'Man on the Moon', do you really not want to restart it?" Shu Ying followed Yu Lu and met with several big bosses. Many business cards were distributed, and those who were willing to give her a chance were all commercial projects.

Firstly, Shu Ying had been silent for several years, and secondly, she was unwilling to reveal her father, a well-known writer, which meant she had no capital behind her.

"The Man Who Fished for the Moon" is one of the most obscure short stories among Shu's father's works, and it is also Shu Ying's favorite. When she was drunk in the dormitory, she said that she wanted to put this novel on the big screen.

Yu Lu didn't want Shu Ying's talent to be buried, and said with a bit of resentment: "Almost all of Shu Ya's works have been filmed in the past few years, but this one has never been authorized. If you want to film it, why will people buy it?"

"It's not good yet." Shu Ying shook his head, "I'm worried about Mianmian."

Yu Lu sighed inwardly, wondering why her beautiful sister, who was good at everything, had such a bumpy journey.
